purpose: Locate the first stage losing observed street structure; no mission dispatch and no superiority claim
vae_reconstruction: mode and fixed-seed sample on city RGB, RGBD projection, and official first archive RGB
metrics: unchanged past_view and forecast_consistency plus full-frame RGB MAE; no threshold adjustment

reference.selection: first archived RGB file of first trajectory of first shard, fixed before viewing/inference; repeat 16 times for stationary identity diagnostic
reference.limitations: No trajectory labels or depth used. Synthetic static context, not held-out navigation benchmark. Dataset metadata declares Apache-2.0; raw reference media remains private in this diagnostic.
reference.download_notes: Earlier full-trajectory attempt aborted on metadata >192MiB; consecutive-frame range attempt interrupted after sparse frame IDs found. No images selected by inference result.

interpretation_limits: Single scene, single seed. No generalized domain conclusion.
All cases are stationary identities, not future ground truth or obstacle prediction.
Full-observed projection and zero time are diagnostic interventions, not operational fixes.
Preserve all outcomes and runtime errors. No favorable-case selection.
